Replace.Text: 城市人口增长速度+100%。
+100% city growth rate in the city.
城市中生产开拓者时+100% [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力，生产的开拓者不计入 [ICON_Citizen] 人口。
+100% [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production toward Settlers in this city. Settlers trained in the city do not consume a [ICON_Citizen] Population.
城市中格位收获和移除地貌的产出+100%。
+100% yields from plot harvests and feature removals in city.
在城市中进行太空计划项目时+100% [ICON_Production] 生产力。在城市中进行核武器项目时+100% [ICON_Production] 生产力。
100% [ICON_Production] Production increase to all space-program projects in the city. +100% [ICON_Production] Production increase to all nuclear armament projects in the city.
城市中每位 [ICON_Citizen] 公民每回合可带来+0.7 [ICON_CULTURE] 文化值，解锁人文主义市政后翻倍。
城市中每位 [ICON_Citizen] 公民每回合可带来+0.7 [ICON_SCIENCE] 科技值，解锁印刷术科技后翻倍。
+0.7 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture per turn for each [ICON_Citizen] Citizen in the city, double after civic Humanism unlocks.
+0.7 [ICON_SCIENCE] Science per turn for each [ICON_Citizen] Citizen in the city, double after tech Printing unlocks.
城市每回合产出的 [ICON_Science] 科技值和 [ICON_Culture] 文化值+20%。
20% increase in [ICON_Science] Science and [ICON_Culture] Culture generated by the city.
城市中著作、艺术、文物和音乐巨作提供的 [ICON_Tourism] 旅游业绩+200%。
+200% [ICON_Tourism] Tourism from Great Works of Art, Artifact, Music, and Writing in the city.
人才计划
Talent plan
建筑（包括奇观）修建完成时可获得等同于修建所耗生产力20%的 [ICON_Science] 科技值和 [ICON_Culture] 文化值。
Gain [ICON_Science] Science and [ICON_Culture] Culture equal to 20% of the construction cost when finishing buildings (including wonders).
城市获得新单元格的速度加快100%。
Acquire new tiles in city 100% faster.
城市中每位 [ICON_Citizen] 公民每回合可带来1 [ICON_Gold] 金币的收入，解锁银行业科技后额外+1 [ICON_Gold] 金币。
+1 [ICON_Gold] Gold per turn for each [ICON_Citizen] Citizen in the city, +1 [ICON_Gold] Gold after tech Banking unlocks
本城市4个单元格范围内的每个未改良的地貌+2 [ICON_Gold] 金币。
+2 [ICON_Gold] Gold for each unimproved feature within 4 tiles of this city.
大投资商
Investor
建筑（包括奇观）修建完成时可获得等同修建所耗生产力40%的 [ICON_Gold] 金币。
Gain [ICON_Gold] Gold equal to 40% of the construction cost when finishing buildings (including wonders).
可持续经济
Sustainable Economy
城市中所有包含地貌或自然奇观的单元格+1 [ICON_TOURISM] 旅游业绩，研究“飞行”科技后再额外+1 [ICON_TOURISM] 旅游业绩。该城市中与未改良地貌相邻的单元格可获得+2魅力。

+1 [ICON_TOURISM] Tourism to all of this city's tiles with a feature or natural wonder, additional +1 [ICON_TOURISM] Tourism after Flight is researched. Tiles adjacent to unimproved features receive +2 Appeal in this city.
精兵
Veteran
此城中生产的所有军事单位若初始未拥有免费升级，则其初始可获得一项免费升级。
Military units trained in this city start with a free promotion that do not already start with a free promotion.
城市每回合获得一次额外的 [ICON_Ranged] 远程攻击机会。您在9个单元格内的其他城市每回合获得对您文明的6点 [ICON_PressureUp] 忠诚度。
City gains an additional [ICON_Ranged] Ranged Strike per turn. Your other cities within 9 tiles gain +6 [ICON_PressureUp] Loyalty per turn towards your civilization.
生产单位所需战略资源花费减少80%。
Strategic resource costs for units are discounted 80%.
城市领土内的单位防御时可+5 [ICON_Strength] 战斗力。城市中储存的战略资源每回合额外增加2点。
Units defending within the city's territory get +5 [ICON_Strength] Combat Strength. Accumulating Strategic resources in the city gain an additional +2 per turn.
城市驻军 [ICON_Strength] 战斗力+5。就职城市无法被围攻。就职仅需2回合。
Increases city garrison [ICON_Strength] Combat Strength by +5. City cannot be put under siege. Establishes in 2 turns.
军事统帅
General
本城4个单元格以内的单位+5 [ICON_Strength] 战斗力、+1 [ICON_Movement] 移动力。
+5 [ICON_Strength] Combat Strength and +1 [ICON_Movement] Movement for units within 4 tiles of this city.
军备竞赛倡导者
Arms race proponent
解锁对应市政后可直接生产军团和军队、舰队和无敌舰队且训练费用降低20%。防御飞机和洲际弹道导弹的攻击时，位于城市领土中的防空支援单位+25 [ICON_Strength] 战斗力。

Allows Corps and Army, Fleet and Armada to be trained directly after researching the required civics, training costs reduced 20%. +25 [ICON_Strength] Combat Strength to anti-air support units within the city's territory when defending against aircraft and ICBMs.
可派遣至城邦，效力等同于3名 [ICON_Envoy] 使者。也可派遣至其他文明的 [ICON_Capital] 首都。
Can be assigned to a city-state, where she acts as 3 [ICON_Envoy] Envoys. Can also be assigned to a [ICON_Capital] Capital of other civilization.
9个单元格内其他文明的城市每回合将失去3点 [ICON_PressureDown] 忠诚度。每条经过此城市的外国 [ICON_TradeRoute] 贸易路线每回合的 [ICON_Gold] 金币+3。
Other cities within 9 tiles and not owned by you lose 3 [ICON_PressureDown] Loyalty per turn. +3 [ICON_Gold] Gold per turn from each foreign [ICON_TradeRoute] Trade Route passing through the city.
在外国 [ICON_Capital] 首都就职时，此文明的任何城市皆无法对您的城市施加忠诚度压力。9个单元格内的间谍执行进攻性任务时行动时间-25%。
When established in a foreign [ICON_Capital] Capital, none of the owner's cities exert Loyalty pressure on your cities. -25% offensive missions operation time for spies within 9 tiles.
外交大臣
Diplomacy
在外国 [ICON_Capital] 首都就职时，此文明对您的 [ICON_STAT_GRIEVANCE] 不满每回合多降低1点。若该文明为盟友，同盟点数每回合额外增加0.5。

When established in a foreign [ICON_Capital] Capital, [ICON_STAT_GRIEVANCE] Grievances from the city owner against you are reduced by 1 more per turn. If this is an allied foreign [ICON_Capital] Capital, your Alliance Points with the owner increase an extra .5 per turn.
派遣到城邦后将获得该城邦的奢侈品资源。相当于额外派遣了1名 [ICON_Envoy] 使者。
While established in a city-state, provides a copy of its Luxury resources to you. Acts as 1 more [ICON_Envoy] Envoy.
在城邦中就职后将储备该城邦的战略资源。成为宗主国后，获得的战略资源储备将加倍。相当于额外派遣了1名 [ICON_Envoy] 使者。
While established in a city-state, accumulate its Strategic resources. When suzerain receive double the amount of accumulated strategic resources. Acts as 1 more [ICON_Envoy] Envoy.
此城中生产的使徒和武僧首次升级时将额外获得1次升级。此城招募的传教士和使徒+1传教次数。
Apostles and Warrior Monks trained in the city receive 1 extra promotion when receiving their first promotion. Missionary and Apostles created here have +1 spread.
所有单位在此城的单元格中1回合即可完全恢复体力。此城的 [ICON_GreatWork_Relic] 遗物带来的 [ICON_Tourism] 旅游业绩翻倍。
All units heal fully in one turn in tiles of this city. [ICON_GreatWork_Relic] Relic in this city provide double [ICON_Tourism] Tourism.
在此城的单元格中进行神学战斗时+10 [ICON_Religion] 宗教战斗力。城市将不会受到来自非 [ICON_Governor] 总督所属文明宗教的压力。
+10 [ICON_Religion] Religious Strength in theological combat in tiles of this city. City ignores religious pressure from Religions not founded by the [ICON_Governor] Governor's player.
建筑（包括奇观）修建完成时可获得等同修建所耗生产力40%的 [ICON_FAITH] 信仰值。
Gain [ICON_FAITH] Faith equal to 40% of the construction cost when finishing buildings (including wonders).
此城对相邻城市释放的宗教压力强度加倍。圣地区+2 [ICON_GreatProphet] 大预言家点数。
Religious pressure to adjacent cities is 100% stronger from this city. +2 [ICON_GreatProphet] GreatProphet points for Holy site.
大圣城
Holy city
3个单元格范围内的所有圣地区 [ICON_Faith] 信仰值相邻加成+50%。
+50% [ICON_Faith] Faith adjacency bonus for all Holy sites within 3 tiles of this city.
黄金六城
Golden cities
位于此城市第4环的其他城市可重复获得来自其他城市的建筑 [ICON_Production] 生产力和 [ICON_Gold] 金币的加成延伸效果，哪怕是来自相同的建筑。
Cities located at 4 tiles away from this city receive [ICON_Production] Production and [ICON_Gold] Gold from all nearby buildings with regional bonuses, not just the first.
本城市3个单元格范围内的每处战略资源+2 [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力，每处奢侈品资源+2 [ICON_Gold] 金币。
+2 [ICON_PRODUCTION] production for all stategy resources and +2 [ICON_Gold] Gold for all luxury resources within 3 tiles of this city.
任意发电厂中的每项资源所产生的 [ICON_POWER] 电力+2。解锁显示对应资源的科技后，每回合获得5点（标准速度下） [ICON_RESOURCE_COAL] 煤和 [ICON_RESOURCE_OIL] 石油。

Increases the [ICON_POWER] Power provided by each resource of the Power Plant by 2. +5 [ICON_RESOURCE_COAL] Coal and [ICON_RESOURCE_OIL] Oil per turn (on Standard Speed) after unlocking the tech that reveals these resources.
此城市可重复获得来自其他城市的建筑 [ICON_Production] 生产力、[ICON_Science] 科技值、[ICON_Culture] 文化值、[ICON_Gold] 金币的加成延伸效果，哪怕是来自相同的建筑。
This city receives [ICON_PRODUCTION] production, [ICON_Science] Science, [ICON_Culture] Culture, and [ICON_Gold] Gold from all nearby buildings with regional bonuses, not just the first.
建筑大师
Master of construction
本城所有专业化区域的对应相邻加成+50%
+50% corresponding district adjacency bonus for all specialty districts in this city.
在城市中修建区域时+50% [ICON_Production] 生产力。该城市可无视 [ICON_Citizen] 人口数量限制再建造一个区域。
+50% [ICON_Production] Production towards constructing districts in the city. This city can build one more district than usual (exceeding the normal limit based on [ICON_Citizen] Population).
雄伟建筑
Grand Architecture
此城市每个世界奇观额外产出3点所有类型产出。
All wonders in this city provide +3 for all types of yields.
旅游胜地
Resort
此城市的 [ICON_Tourism] 旅游业绩+100%。
This city provides double [ICON_Tourism] Tourism.
环境效应无法对此城市的改良设施、建筑与区域造成伤害。此城市的忠诚度固定为100%。
This city’s improvements, buildings, and districts cannot be damaged by Environmental Effects. This city has 100% loyalty.
此城市的每个社区、水渠、运河与堤坝+1 [ICON_AMENITIES] 宜居度和+1 [ICON_Housing] 住房。解锁电力科技后，获得10点可再生 [ICON_POWER] 电力。
+1 [ICON_AMENITIES] Amenity and +1 [ICON_Housing] Housing for every Neighborhoods, Aqueduct, Canal and Dam district in this city. Gain 10 [ICON_POWER] free power after tech electricity unlocks.
+5 [ICON_Strength] 战斗力（维克多）。
+5 [ICON_Strength] Combat Strength (the defender).
+1 [ICON_Movement] 移动力（维克多）。
+1 [ICON_Movement] Movement (the defender).
